title: Support
intro: We're here to help you with Repp. If you have issues with your account, workouts, app access, personal data or any other question, write to us at support@repp.community.

contact.heading: Contact
contact.body1: To get help, send us an email at support@repp.community with a description of the issue. If you can, include the email associated with your account, your device model, the iOS or Android version and relevant screenshots.
contact.body2: We try to respond within 2 to 3 business days. Times may vary depending on the volume of requests.

topics.heading: Frequent topics
list: Issues signing in or recovering access to your account.
Questions about routines, training history or progress.
Technical errors, sync failures or unexpected behavior.
Requests related to privacy, personal data or account deletion.
Comments, suggestions or reports to improve the app.

privacy.heading: Privacy and data
privacy.body: If you want to request access, correction or deletion of your personal data, write to us at support@repp.community. You can also review our Privacy Policy to learn how we collect, use and protect your information.

purchases.heading: Purchases and subscriptions
purchases.body: If your request is related to payments, in-app purchases or subscriptions, include any useful detail to locate the case. Refunds and billing may depend on the policies of the store where you made the purchase.

legal.heading: Legal information
legal.body: To learn the rules for using Repp, review our Terms and Conditions.
